policies.title: Romanian ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bangladesh Police Special Branch states that tourists from European countries may obtain a visa on arrival at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.
conditions: Applies to Romanian ordinary-passport tourists as members of the page's European-country category, for arrival at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.
The visa is a single-entry visa for no more than 30 days and is issued only after the immigration officer reviews the required documents and compliance.
Applicants must meet the stated passport, return-ticket, funds and fee requirements and should use the same port for entry and departure.
This policy does not cover prohibited-country cases, work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic or official passports, special travel documents, or final admission.

policies.title: Romanian ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's current national tourism-board table specifically states that Romanian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary Romanian visitor baseline represented by the tourism board's nationality table.
The tourism board requires travelers to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the issued QR code at check-in and boarding.
The listed arrival visa costs 40 JOD; passport validity, purpose, border-point availability, security screening and final admission remain applicable.
This policy does not establish work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document treatment.

policies.title: Romanian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy visitor schedule expressly places Romania in its no-visa-required cohort for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Romanian passport for the short tourist treatment in the embassy's no-visa-required schedule, for up to three months.
The embassy separately advises at least three months of passport validity, a round-trip ticket and proof of economic solvency; border screening and final admission remain applicable.
This policy does not establish work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document treatment.
